rows.note: C-80: size depth measured from the CIRs' certified size run (cir/graded.size_run) or UNMEASURED; cir.compile/gate.certify lane-counted through inputs.cir.slug; the fast/flagship mix binds on measured job-seconds at the claim even at pool 3.

C-80: function budgets by largest remainder over the pool; a function over its share of the last 24h measured job-seconds yields at the claim while an under-share function has runnable work (Worker.run_once).
C-80: backoff stores last_counted_job_id and increments only on a new unchanged observation with an absolute deadline; suspension lifts on a changed hypothesis (C-85 closes the new-SHA lift).
C-80: SERP, culture, insights and MJs benchmark listings stamped with source/population/window; radar.score discounts by the stamped evidence and the discounted score decides promotion.

C-80: moat inventory from artefact evidence; recognisability carries its basis -- the signature count is labelled recognisability_proxy and the real measurement (blind hero description against the brand palette) runs behind image_vision and overrides the proxy when present. Parked for the measured half only.

C-80: rollback rehearsed (dry withdrawal round trip per listing), search baseline from listing.query_portfolio per release, live-Etsy owner asks withheld at the handler while any package item is BUILD-blocked. The pre-launch TRAFFIC baseline stays UNMEASURED until the owner exports Etsy Stats (insights_access) -- parked for that half only.

C-80: every frame role has a registered claim (unregistered = UNCLAIMED, blocking); unjudged stays unjudged; a review counts only when non-empty, all clear and bound to the stored frame shas. With image_vision closed every frame is UNREVIEWED and publication is blocked -- honest; the independent review itself waits on the gate.

C-80: rungs are distinct strategies (GENERATION_RUNGS/RUNG_BRIEFS) with persisted creative.escalation_result; parity.assess starts from the persisted attempt; owned_photography.make takes rung constraints with its own budget; change_tool alternates provider. Proved through store.publish + the photography job rung by rung; gate state read live.
C-80: delight drivers read from THIS version's artefacts (provenance filtered slug@version); customization from the real size run; nothing-to-read stays unscored, never neutral.
